Priyanka (Hiring Manager): New PM starts next Mon. Can someone drop a tiny manager-first-week checklist + a copy-paste welcome DM? Keep it <1 page. Main needs: access matrix, 30/60/90 bullets, and 3 success signs.
Drew (People Ops): Quick version below  manager-editable. Paste into the candidate DM or templates.
Sam (IT): I'll start the device order and SSO. Priyanka DM the OS and shipping addr. Note: VPN/HSM add 3 business days.
Elena (Buddy): Happy to buddy. I can run a 45-min product tour day 1 and a pairing session day 2.
Marcus (Eng Lead): I'll create a tiny onboarding ticket (CI run + staging deploy) for day 1. Good safety win.
Drew (People Ops): Manager one-page checklist (copy/paste):
```
PRE-DAY
- Confirm OS & shipping with IT; list SaaS needed (Figma, Looker, Amplitude)
- Create SSO/email invites and Slack account; add to team calendar + #team intro
- Assign buddy and add a \"who-to-ask\" note

DAY 0 (welcome)
- Send welcome DM + benefits link; post short intro in #team
- Verify email/Slack access and SSO login

DAY 1
- 60-min product + roadmap walkthrough (mgr + buddy)
- Verify repo/staging access; assign tiny onboarding ticket

DAY 2
- Pair on ticket; run CI/test deploy; introduce monitoring dashboards

DAY 3
- Stakeholder intros (15-20m each) and metrics tour

DAY 4
- Align on 30/60/90 and set measurable 30-day goal
- Schedule recurring 1:1s (weekly x8) and a 2-week feedback check

MANAGER DELIVERABLES
- Provide written 30/60/90 & 3 success signals by EOW
- Approve SaaS/device pre-day; add buddy & calendar invites
- Assign the tiny ticket and review first PR within week 2
```
Priyanka (Hiring Manager): Great. Can you add a short 30/60/90 I can DM to the hire?
Drew (People Ops): Pasteable 30/60/90 (3 bullets):
- 30 days: complete onboarding checklist, run CI/staging ticket, deliver a 1-page discovery note with next steps.
- 60 days: own a small backlog area, run one cross-team sync, merge independent PRs with clear acceptance criteria.
- 90 days: lead a scoped release that moves a target metric and maintain routine stakeholder cadence.
Elena (Buddy): Who-to-ask (quick): repos -> Marcus (Eng Lead), infra -> #eng-infra, deploys -> Devops (Samir), metrics -> Data Eng (Lee). I'll paste into the doc.
Marcus (Eng Lead): Ticket created: `onboard/ci-check`  simple PR that runs CI and verifies a staging deploy. Will assign Day1.
Drew (People Ops): Three quick success signals (manager-editable):
- 30d: CI ticket green, discovery note submitted, onboarding tasks complete
- 60d: >=3 merged PRs, led a sync with notes, owns backlog card for area X
- 90d: led a release with measurable metric improvement, stakeholder 1:1 cadence established
Sam (IT): Device ordered. ETA 3 business days. SSO invites sent; temporary cloud dev env available if MDM blocks.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: \"New PM - Day0 welcome\" scheduled for 2024-06-10 09:00. :bell:
Priyanka (Hiring Manager): Perfect  thanks. Can someone also drop a one-liner welcome DM I can send to the candidate?
Drew (People Ops): One-liner DM (paste):
\"Hi Aisha — welcome to Redwood Inference! Quick agenda for week 1: Day0 admin + Slack intro, Day1 product walkthrough, Day2 pairing on a tiny ticket, Day3 stakeholder intros. Your buddy is Elena. We'll send a short 30/60/90 and three success signals by EOW. Any access or device questions ping Sam (IT). Looking forward to having you on the team!\" 
Priyanka (Hiring Manager): I'll send that. Thanks all
